title: India vs China
shortAnswer: India has overtaken China as the world's most populous country with 1.44B people. China has a much larger economy ($17.7T vs $3.7T) but India has faster GDP growth and a younger population.
verdict: China is far ahead economically but India's demographics and growth rate give it strong long-term potential.

lines.hook: India has more people than China. That hasn't been true in all of modern history.
lines.tape: China owns today's economy. India owns the clock.
rounds: 1.44 billion against 1.4 billion. The crown changed hands, and it isn't going back.
$17.7 trillion to $3.7 trillion. China's economy is nearly five times bigger.
6.5% against 4.5%. India adds growth faster every single year the gap holds.
Median age 28.4 versus 39. India's workers are entering their prime as China's retire.
lines.verdict: India takes it 3-1 on trajectory. Want power right now, China is still the answer.

youtubeTitle: India vs China: Who Actually Wins the Next 30 Years?
youtubeDescription:
India now has the world's largest population at 1.44 billion, faster GDP growth at 6.5%, and a median age over ten years younger than China's. China still holds a commanding economic lead with a $17.7 trillion GDP versus India's $3.7 trillion. We compare population, GDP, growth rate, and median age to see which country is really ahead.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/india-vs-china
